sentences.en: Do you know where I might find small cowboy boots?
sentences.zh: 你知道哪里能买到小号牛仔靴吗？

sentences.en: It became popular among young people to wear hunting boots.
sentences.zh: 穿狩猎靴在年轻人中很流行。

sentences.en: He is very proud and will never lick anyone's boots.
sentences.zh: 他非常有骨气，绝不会巴结任何人。

phrases.zh: 我的靴子（表示拒绝或不满）

senses.zh: 靴子；长统靴；(英)汽车行李箱
